verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only one-off scheduling of a single email send at a specific date and time, event-triggered RSS/blog emails, and simple workflows that run after an email is sent. None of this documents a recurring schedule for jobs or workflows, and a one-off scheduled send or an event trigger cannot stand in for one, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
